severity_note: diagnostic output only, but every PartDiam ever printed is wrong by one and base-N graphs print zero; agrees with the review
evidence: 'distmax = 0; /* Start distances from zero */' then 'connval = ++ distmax; /* Start from previous distance */' so the root sits at distance 1; 'while ((rootnum < grafptr->vertnbr) && ...' with rootnum starting at baseval; 'diamval = graphMapView3 (grafptr, pidxtax, mapnum); diamsum += diamval;' with 'return (-1);' on allocation failure.
review_accuracy: accurate; its fix line (compare with vertnnd, start at 0, handle -1) is what the patch does. first_pass_critique: Right on status and evidence. Its preferred diff keeps counting from one and subtracts one at the return with a clamp ('(distmax > 0) ? (distmax - 1) : 0'), which hides the off-by-one rather than removing it and makes the error code collide with a legitimate value only by accident; it also bundled an unrelated API-22 hunk (graphPartOvlView return) into the same sketch. The preferred patch here starts distmax at -1 so that 'connval = ++ distmax' is zero for the first component, and checks the -1 return in the caller.

our_title: Edge load sum counts arcs with loads but edges without, in both stat routines
ran: repro/API-19/stat_pristine (4-path, 3 edges): 'no loads: edlosum=3', 'unit loads: edlosum=6', 'loads 2,5,3: edlosum=20'; mpirun -np 1/2/3 dstat_pristine: same three numbers. Patched: 3 / 3 / 10 everywhere, averages unchanged. gtst and dgtst on data/m4x4_b1_ev.grf: 'Edge load ... sum=118' -> 'sum=59' (above 'Edge nbr=24'); unweighted graphs unchanged; check_prog_gtst and check_prog_dgtst pass.
severity_note: documented API output inconsistent by a factor two; agrees with the review
evidence: 'edlosum += srcgrafptr->edlotax[edgenum];' over 'for all edges' (arcs) versus 'edlosum = srcgrafptr->edgenbr / 2;'; distributed: 'edlolocsum += edlolocval;' reduced into edloglbsum versus 'edloglbsum = srcgrafptr->edgeglbnbr / 2;'. Doc (s_l.tex:3772-3775, p_l.tex:2565-2568): 'the sum of all edge loads'; the same manual says 'edgenbr is the number of arcs (that is, twice the number of edges)' (s_l.tex:2946), and gtst prints 'Edge nbr=' as edgenbr / 2 right above the load line.
review_accuracy: accurate on the inconsistency; it leaves the convention open
first_pass_critique: Right on status and evidence; it preferred the arc convention on the strength of the internal Graph.edlosum field, i.e. the opposite of what the user manual and gtst's own 'Edge nbr' line support, and it did not touch the doc. our_title: Distributed histogram division by cmlosum is guarded implicitly by cdstmax
ran: Source analysis confirmed by the differential runs: library_dgraph_map_stat.c:379-383 sets cdstmax to the highest non-zero cell of the unhalved histogram, -1 if all are zero; cmlosum is the (halved) sum of those cells, so cmlosum == 0 implies cdstmax == -1 and the loop at library_dgraph_map_view.c:150 does not execute. Edge loads cannot be negative (graphCheck/dgraphCheck). dview on a graph whose mapped part has no edges was not constructible with dgraphMapCompute (every vertex is mapped).
severity_note: lower than the first pass's 'low': the division is never reached with a zero divisor
evidence: 'for (cdstnum = 0; cdstnum <= cdstmax; cdstnum ++) ... (double) cdsttab[cdstnum] / (double) cmlosum' with cdstmax from 'for (cdstmax = 255; cdstmax != -1; cdstmax --) if (cdstglbtab[cdstmax] != 0) break;' and cmlosum = sum of cdstglbtab[0..255] / 2. The sequential view has the identical structure (library_graph_map_view.c:522-528).
review_accuracy: not in the review (first pass finding)
first_pass_critique: Wrong: labelled still-present/low on a source read without checking how cdstmax is derived; the same structure exists in the sequential view it compared against.
